quality.name: Stage Lighting
quality.hint: Your own setting only. Full draws the cast lit by the room: graded into its colour, outlined and glowing, with the backdrop softened behind them. Lite draws the same staging as plain pictures, for a machine the full effect slows down.

breath.name: Idle Breathing
breath.hint: A slow breathing sway on every character on stage while nothing else moves. Off by default; applies to every client.

director.name: Stage Director
director.label: Open the Director
director.hint: Cast, staging, the scene's light and the comms, in one panel.

warn.art: Stage could not read {src} for lighting. Serve it from this server, or from a host that sends CORS headers.

director.title: Stage Director
director.gmOnly: Only the GM can direct the stage.
director.writeFailed: Stage: that change could not be saved. See the console for details.

stage.emptyStrip: Nobody is on stage. Bring someone on from the cast list.
stage.dragHint: Drag across to move · up and down for depth
stage.wideHint: Pull back from the close-up to the whole stage.
stage.spreadHint: Space everyone evenly, keeping their order.
stage.clearHint: Send everyone off. The stage stays up on the empty room.
stage.full: The stage is full ({max} at most).
stage.flip: Turn to face the other way
stage.reactFailed: That reaction could not be sent.

layout.title: Stage layout
layout.figureHint: How tall a character of height ×1 stands, as a share of the screen height.
layout.floorHint: Where feet meet the floor: up from (or below) the bottom edge of the screen.
layout.widthHint: How much of the screen width the marks span.

cast.fromTokensHint: Add a character for every selected token, using its actor's portrait.
cast.dropHint: Drop an Actor on this window to add it.
cast.empty: The cast is empty. Add a character, import selected tokens, or drop an Actor here.
cast.nothingSelected: Pick a character from the list to edit them.
cast.noTokens: Select one or more tokens on the canvas first.
cast.imported: Added {n} to the cast ({skipped} already in it).
cast.dropFailed: That Actor could not be found.
cast.lineupHint: Everyone on one floor at their relative heights. Adjust heights until they look right side by side.
cast.name: Name
cast.titlePlaceholder: Shown under the name on the name card

faces.label: Art faces
faces.hint: Which way the character looks as drawn, so the stage can turn them into the scene.

cast.tintHint: The colour of this character's comms card.
cast.heightHint: Relative height: a child is about ×0.7, an ogre ×1.3.
cast.offsetXHint: Shift the art sideways, as a share of its own width.
cast.offsetYHint: Lift (or lower) the art, for empty space under the feet or a cropped waist.
cast.faceHint: Click the centre of the face to frame the close-up.
cast.faceSet: Close-up framed on the point you set.
cast.faceAuto: Close-up framed automatically. Click the face to set it by hand.
cast.deleteBody: Remove {name} from the cast? They also leave the stage and the comms.

light.noScene: No scene is being viewed. Open a scene to light it.
light.moodHint: Auto reads the backdrop. The others describe a room; the dials below push or soften it.
light.offHint: Off: the cast is drawn exactly as painted. The dials have no effect.
light.angleHint: Where the front light comes from: 0° above, 90° right, −90° left.
light.darknessHint: Dim the cast with Foundry's darkness level.
light.flickerHint: Let a firelit room's light breathe.
light.srcHint: Light the cast from this image instead of the scene's background.

comms.full: Too many calls at once ({max} at most).
comms.none: No one is on the line.
comms.shiftHint: Nudge the stack up or down, as a share of the screen height.

strength.name: Strength
strength.hint: Master amount. 0 shows the art as painted on a sharp backdrop.

match.name: Match
match.hint: How far the cast takes on the room's colour, brightness and black point.

key.name: Key light
key.hint: How strongly the front light models the figure.

rim.name: Rim
rim.hint: Edge light: the bright line round the silhouette and the backdrop's lamps catching it.

glow.name: Glow
glow.hint: Bloom, halo and light wrapping round the edges.

blur.name: Backdrop blur
blur.hint: Depth of field on the backdrop behind the cast.

grain.name: Grain
grain.hint: Film grain over the whole frame.
